business_summary: Kandenko Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in electrical and piping work, and other facility construction work in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the installation and expansion of electrical facilities, air conditioning systems, and water supply and drainage systems in various buildings, including office buildings, factories, hotels, commercial facilities, educational facilities, and hospitals; diagnostics and renovation services, such as energy conservation and reduction of carbon dioxide emissions; and planning, proposals, construction, maintenance, repair and services. It also constructs power, control, monitoring, and communication facilities for factories, waste disposal plants, recycling facilities, water supply and sewerage facilities, and power plants; designs, constructs, and maintains network infrastructure facilities, such as fiber optic cable networks, mobile phone base stations, CATV broadcasting facilities, and transmission lines for local governments; constructs and maintains overhead and underground power distribution facilities; handles restoration work following natural disasters such as earthquakes, typhoons, and lightning strikes; electrical equipment and electricity sales; and real estate rental and leasing. In addition, it builds wind and solar power plants, and installs cables connecting them to the power grid; and constructs substation facilities, power transmission lines, and electrical facilities within nuclear power plants. Kandenko Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Kandenko Co.,Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본 및 해외에서 전기, 배관 공사, 기타 시설 공사에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 사무용 건물, 공장, 호텔, 상업 시설, 교육 시설, 병원 등 다양한 건물의 전기 시설, 공조 시스템, 상하수도 시스템의 설치 및 확장을 담당하고 있습니다. 에너지 보존 및 이산화탄소 배출 감소와 같은 진단 및 개조 서비스; 기획, 제안, 건설, 유지보수, 수리 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 공장, 폐기물 처리장, 재활용 시설, 상하수도 시설, 발전소의 전력, 제어, 모니터링 및 통신 시설을 건설합니다. 광섬유 케이블 네트워크, 휴대폰 기지국, CATV 방송 시설, 지방 정부의 전송 라인과 같은 네트워크 기반 시설을 설계, 건설 및 유지 관리합니다. 가공 및 지하 배전 시설을 건설하고 유지합니다. 지진, 태풍, 낙뢰 등 자연재해 발생 시 복구작업을 담당합니다.
